dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project is to: 1) Improve our knowledge of the ecology of berry producing species and monitor berry productivity (g/m) in relation to environmental changes;  2) Document natural variability in distribution and abundance of berry producing species;  3) Establish long-term berry monitoring in collaboration with communities and schools;  4) Study relations between snow and berry productivity;  5) Monitor soil surface temperature with micro dataloggers (HOBO PendantsR, Onset Scientific); 6) Collect local ecological knowledge (LEK) through interviews with local experts conducted by students in the classroom or as homework.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Schools
dct_title_s: Community-based berry productivity monitoring in Nunavik in collaboration with Kativik School Board
